g.text: Training-side CV only · same 25% ridge / 75% tree pair in every row · no SDO images
First four rows use unweighted fitting. Last row blends 25% of a fast-case-weighted fit with 75% unweighted.
1,512 validation windows; 291 observed ≥500 and 82 observed ≥600. Selected CV scores are optimistic development estimates.
